items.difficulty_reason: 9 行、构造全分歧 q 次扩张：特征 0 时添 π 的 q 次根（pull-root-uniformizer 引理）；特征 p 时取显式方程 z^q − π^n z = π^{1−q}，换元 y = πz 化为 y^q − π^{n+q−1}y = π，得可分 q 次全分歧扩张、分歧指数 q，取 π_B = y 即满足 π_B^q = π + π^n b 与 π_B^q = π + π_B^{nq} b'。承重全在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the characteristic-zero case given by adjoining a q-th root of the uniformizer via the pull-root-uniformizer lemma, and the characteristic-p case given by the explicit Artin-Schreier-type equation z^q - pi^n z = pi^{1-q} whose rescaled root y = pi z satisfies y^q - pi^{n+q-1} y = pi and serves as a uniformizer of B (source lines 34652-34660)
